name: riven-postban-frames
description: Riven after the bans: what the card-level searches keep fixed. The same main deck (the post-ban reference) for each champion on five sets of battlefields and with the other rune split, cheap pilot (sims=4, worlds=2), 400 games per opponent on the same seeds, the post-ban field of lab/specs/deckopt/riven-postban-*.json. The pilot has never played either champion: differences between battlefields or runes for one champion mean more than the gap between champions.
